items.headline: High Wind Warning issued August 17 at 6:16PM AKDT until August 18 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 70 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
Travel will be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Wind gusts will diminish through Monday night.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued August 17 at 12:01PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Upper Koyukuk Valley-Central Interior-South Slopes Of The Central
Brooks Range-Lower Koyukuk Valley-Middle Yukon Valley

Areas of up to 2 inches of rainfall are expected from the ongoing
event which may cause significant rises in the smaller headwater
streams that feed the Koyukuk and Middle Yukon Rivers.  As mainstem
rivers are currently low, there are no concerns for the larger rivers
in the area.

Rainfall rates are expected to decrease by Tuesday afternoon.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued August 17 at 11:00AM AKDT until August 17 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult by air, land, and sea.
Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.
